timing.GameCube: FASTscans while waitingpoll→idleOtherCore→UpdateOutputs/report assignments→conditional send ifpollvalid→resumeOtherCore. OLED core cannot render during this explicit idle section. Subsequent display still has no proof conditional send happened or which report frame it describes.
timing.Switch: Wait ready→FASTscan→UpdateOutputs→report assignments→send. Display does not inspect that report or delivery. While blocked before update, prior native values can persist.
timing.XInput: FASTscan→UpdateOutputs→report assignments→return on timeout or send. OLED can show a native output even when timeout prevented send.
timing.coherence_limit: Live reads can combine observations from different output iterations; GC core-idling prevents simultaneous eval/render in its critical section but does not latch a complete OLED frame to one report. Settled-state evidence only; no cadence/latency guarantee measured.
timing.core0: loop calls select_mode then primary SendReport; backend updates native outputs before serialization/send.
timing.core1: loop1 separately renders OLED from live outputs; IntegratedDisplay clears, renders, flushes then handles controls. No numbered frame/report latch, timestamp, generation or copied6-field atomic tuple in these paths.
